description_expanded:
Seagrove Beach

Only 0.2 miles to pristine beaches, vibrant dining spots, and charming boutiques.

Private pool!

Gourmet kitchen, spacious island, chic finishes

5 bikes!

Explore coastal dune lakes and serene state parks

Six-seater golf cart!

5-star restaurants

Fun eateries and boutiques

Sapphire Bay by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Meet Sapphire Bay: five bedrooms, five-and-a-half baths, and endless ways to relax right in the heart of Seagrove Beach. It’s modern, stylish, and made for easy coastal living. Start your mornings with a swim in the heated pool, stretch out on a lounger with your favorite playlist, or fire up the grill for a laid-back dinner under the stars. This backyard was made for long, happy days with the people you love. Inside feels just as good. Open spaces, bright interiors, and comfy sofas make it easy to settle in. The kitchen is ready for waffle stacks, lunch spreads, or fresh-caught seafood dinners shared around the island. When it’s time to explore, Sapphire Bay makes it easy to enjoy the best of 30A.

Ride bikes along quiet streets, stroll to local cafés, or spend hours with your toes in the sand listening to the waves. Fill your days with sunshine, good company, and quiet moments that feel like pure vacation. Our Oversee team keeps everything easy. We’re here every day, with a 24/7 line if anything comes up – so your only job is to relax and enjoy. Overview: - .2 miles to the beach (Eastern Lake Access) In the event of a high outflow at the Eastern Lake access point, please use the Ramsgate access to the west. - 5 bedrooms, 5 ½ baths - Fully equipped gourmet kitchen - Wi-Fi - 5 bikes included - Short walk to the beach - 3088 sq. ft. - Gas Grill - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Suite: Queen bed, en-suite bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, TV, private balcony. - Guest Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, TV, private balcony - Bunk Room: 2 twin bunks with trundles, en-suite bath, TV - Guest Room: Twin over full bunk with trundle, en-suite bath TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
